controlChangeCommands.name: Exp 1 MSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Expression out 1. 0-127 maps to 8-bit even values 0-254 (MSB*2). Pair with CC 11 LSB for odd steps.

controlChangeCommands.name: Exp 2 MSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Expression out 2. 0-127 maps to 8-bit even values 0-254 (MSB*2). Pair with CC 12 LSB for odd steps.

controlChangeCommands.name: Exp 3 MSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Expression out 3. 0-127 maps to 8-bit even values 0-254 (MSB*2). Pair with CC 13 LSB for odd steps.

controlChangeCommands.name: Exp 4 MSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Expression out 4. 0-127 maps to 8-bit even values 0-254 (MSB*2). Pair with CC 14 LSB for odd steps.

controlChangeCommands.name: Exp 1 LSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Fine-tunes expression out 1. Combined 8-bit value = MSB*2 + LSB (0 or 1). Manual example: CC 1 = 100 then CC 11 = 0 -> 200; CC 11 = 1 -> 201.

controlChangeCommands.name: Exp 2 LSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Fine-tunes expression out 2. Combined 8-bit value = MSB*2 + LSB (0 or 1).

controlChangeCommands.name: Exp 3 LSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Fine-tunes expression out 3. Combined 8-bit value = MSB*2 + LSB (0 or 1).

controlChangeCommands.name: Exp 4 LSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Fine-tunes expression out 4. Combined 8-bit value = MSB*2 + LSB (0 or 1).

controlChangeCommands.name: MIDI Channel
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 1-16. Must be sent on the current channel. EXP 1-4 LEDs blink the new channel on success and at power-up.
